title: Griffith Park – Proposed Los Angeles River Bike Path Phase IV Extension
text:
Griffith Park – Proposed Los Angeles River Bike Path Phase IV Extension
  Project – Grant of Right for Construction, Operation, and Maintenance of a Bike
  and Pedestrian Path, and Adjacent Equestrian Trail – Consideration of Final
  Initial Study/ Mitigated Negative Declaration Los Angeles River Phase IV Bike
  Path Project State Clearinghouse No. 2025021226
summary: The commission will consider a grant of right to construct, operate and maintain a bike and pedestrian path with an adjacent equestrian trail as an extension of the Los Angeles River Bike Path in Griffith Park. It will also consider the project's final initial study and mitigated negative declaration.

details.action: grant of right and consideration of mitigated negative declaration

flag.reason: Extends the LA River bike path into Griffith Park, a watched neighborhood and public park.
